ZXE4Pq6bJRLSpyW-xQF8_g.zh: 中亞塔吉克今年截至7/1報告41例,當局表示疫情與牲畜食用被炭疽孢子污染之乾草相關,夏季為流行季節,其高危險族群為農產品相關人員,該國2023-24年分別報告80及102例,當局呼籲應加強牲畜屠宰前之檢查措施。 剛果民主共和國東部北基伍省疫情更新,該省4個衛生區截至5/26報告24例疑病例,及動物死亡案例,WHO協助當局啟動跨部門應對措施,強化監測、治療、社區宣導及跨境協調,以控制疫情。
ZXE4Pq6bJRLSpyW-xQF8_g.en: Tajikistan in Central Asia has reported 41 cases as of 1 July this year. Authorities say the outbreak is linked to livestock eating hay contaminated with anthrax spores. Summer is the epidemic season, and the high-risk group is workers involved with agricultural products. The country reported 80 cases in 2023 and 102 in 2024. Authorities call for strengthened inspection of livestock before slaughter. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the update for North Kivu Province in the east shows that as of 26 May, four health zones in the province had reported 24 suspected cases and animal deaths. WHO is helping authorities launch a multisectoral response, strengthening surveillance, treatment, community awareness and cross-border coordination to control the outbreak.
